author: Codex GPT-6 Central
authority: Soberano approves sealed holdout, exact-head merge and promotion
target: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct LoRA-r8 — same source/base, independent quality measurement

comparison.known_confound: Four-step job altered both number of steps and train-sample selection

arms.meaning: Deterministic independent validator, reference not model response

comparison.reuse: Existing E0 scorers, TRAIN-01 H02 HOST oracle, S1 grant validator, TRAIN-02 B/C OS fence and meta_harness/improvement metadata aggregation; no new training service

holdout.sample_construction: External source-family cases, unseen by train or exposed DEV; HOST computes gold before any model call; no model generates oracle
holdout.raw_inputs_policy: OWNER_LOCAL_ONLY; never publish prompts, raw replies, identifiers or exact owner paths
holdout.contamination_policy: Exclude TRAIN 64 examples, exposed E0/A07, hard DEV 112, V2/V3 42 and older public 24; no item or source-family overlap
holdout.unseal_gate: Independent custodian commits root SHA256 and answer-key hash before model receives prompts; TRAIN/DEV hash and source lineage checked first

inference_protocol.systemd_fence: Reuse TRAIN-02 C owner-scoped MemoryMax/thermal/GPU-exclusion, no shell effect delegated to LLM
inference_protocol.runtime_cache: No cross-arm KV reuse; record runtime version, tokenizer and head/epoch provenance
inference_protocol.order_control: Randomize arm order by sealed seed, unload and verify GPU baseline between arms
stop_conditions: unverified source family or leaked gold

measurement.primary: Complete strict JSON plus per-field exactness under identical cases; no prefix-only acceptance
measurement.paired_comparison: Case-level paired differences; two runs nested in each case; stratify ES/PT and family; 10000 deterministic block-bootstrap replicates, 95% interval; report absolute pp and per-family n
measurement.success_gate: Candidate improvement >=10 percentage points in strict exactness vs base AND paired 95% lower bound >0; hard veto 0/observed repeats; no family catastrophic regressions; insufficient n remains NO_DATA
measurement.non_promotion_note: Even a significant private blind result needs genuine physical audio and edge E2E x2, independently witnessed S1 grants and human signature

next_piece: Secure independent owner-local blind case custody and source-family audit; freeze template/base/validator, then run bounded preflight and paired D0/D1/D2 on the same holdout. No training until new hypothesis/lease.
